text:
jada: Quick ping — docs-scan flagged a broken anchor in /runtime/changelog (the #quickstart-curl fragment). That makes the onboarding quickstart snippet render as 404 on staging. Anyone owns this doc? cc @kevin @olivia

kevin: I can take this. which anchor exactly?

jada: Link: https://internal.redwood.com/runtime/changelog#quickstart-curl — on staging the fragment jumps to the top instead of the snippet. The heading in the MD is `### Quick start — cURL` but generated id is `quick-start-curl` (em dash vs hyphen). Looks like our heading-to-id normalization changed.

taylor: Small approach: normalize the heading text so the generated id matches links, then add a redirect for old fragments. Example quick patch: 
```bash
git checkout -b docs/fix/changelog-anchor
# edit runtime/changelog.md
sed -E "s/### Quick start — cURL/### Quick start - cURL/" -i runtime/changelog.md
git add runtime/changelog.md && git commit -m "docs: normalize changelog heading id to match quickstart fragment"
```

kevin: Opening PR now. I will also add a short redirect entry in _redirects.md and request cherry-pick to release/v1.2.

docs-bot: docs-preview started for PR #4289 — https://staging.previews.redwood.com/pr/4289 (render in ~2m)

olivia: Happy to review, ping me when CI finishes. Also, can we add a 301-style redirect for external shortlinks just in case?

kevin: Added redirect entry and pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/4289 — includes change + redirect + small commit note.

olivia: LGTM :shipit: — one tiny nit in the commit message (s/heading/id normalization/), not blocking.

kevin: Fixed the commit message and force-pushed; merged to main and cherry-picked to release/v1.2. Preview shows snippet anchor working.

jada: Verified on staging and onboarding flow now resolves to the snippet. Thanks everyone! :tada:
